title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
summary: Mandatory specification for packaged drinking water and bottled water in India.
scope: Covers treatment, microbiological safety, toxic substances, labeling, and mandatory certification requirements for packaged drinking water.

title: Drinking Water — Specification (Second Revision)
summary: Drinking water quality requirements for public and domestic supply.
scope: Specifies drinking water quality in terms of physical, chemical, toxic, and bacteriological parameters.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
summary: Primary code for concrete design and construction in India.
scope: Covers design, material provisions, durability requirements, and detailing for RCC and plain concrete structures.

title: Safety of Toys — Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
summary: Safety of toys and child products sold in India.
scope: Covers mechanical safety, sharp edges, small parts risk, and physical integrity of toys.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Domestic and Similar Purposes — Specification (Fourth Revision)
summary: Electrical plug and socket safety requirements.
scope: Covers domestic plugs, socket-outlets, and accessories up to specified loads with shock and fire protection requirements.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
summary: Mandatory TMT steel bar specification for reinforcement.
scope: Defines chemical and mechanical properties including strength, elongation, and bend behavior of rebars.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
summary: Safety requirements for IT equipment under BIS CRS.
scope: Includes insulation, energy hazard, temperature, and performance safety requirements for IT equipment.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys — Jewellery/Artefacts
scope: Outlines assaying, hallmarking, and purity requirements for precious jewellery and gold artefacts.
